item.title: Longford ICA event to host Christmas Craft Fair on Sunday
item.description: A local Irish Countrywomen's Association branch will host a Christmas Craft Fair this Sunday. The Longford ICA event will take place from 11am to 5pm at the Temperance Hall in Longford. There's free entry and the event is open to people of all ages. There will be a raffle and the opportunity to pick up some handmade gifts for loved ones this Christmas. item.title: Roscommon guard honoured at this year's Bravery Awards
item.description: A Roscommon guard was honoured at this year's Bravery Awards in Leinster House. Garda John Caroll received a bronze medal and a certificate of bravery for a rescue mission he conducted in April 2003. He had responded to reports of a young man entering the River Nore in Kilkenny City and attempted to retrieve him from the water in freezing temperatures and a fast-moving current. item.title: Local Eurovision winner says Ireland's own song contest would be a 'good idea'
item.description: A local Eurovision winner says it would be a 'good idea' for RTÉ to launch its own song contest this year. Charlie McGettigan was speaking to Shannonside Northern Sound following the announcement the state broadcaster will boycott this year's competition over Israel's participation. RTÉ declared it was also making the decision to take a stand against the 'targeted killing of journalists in Gaza.' item.title: Boyle's Christmas lights to be switched on this evening
item.description: As the festive season continues, Boyle's Christmas lights will be switched on this evening. Local groups, businesses, and volunteers have been busy preparing a calendar of winter activities aimed at boosting community spirit and supporting local enterprises. Athlete Thomas Sheridan, who won gold World Rowing Beach Sprint Finals this year will turn on the lights at 4.30pm. item.title: Former justice minister and local TD passes away
item.description: Fine Gael TD and former justice minister Paddy Cooney has passed away at the age of 94. The Longford-Westmeath politician served as minister in the cabinets of Liam Cosgrave and Garrett Fitzgerald. He also was an MEP and senator for Fine Gael. item.title: Longford appoint Gerry Togher as U17 manager
item.description: Gerry Togher has been appointed Longford under 17 football manager. The Clonguish native has been appointed for the 2026 season. Whereas, Togher will step down from his role as Assistant Secretary, having served on the county board. Togher has coaching experience having coached with the underage structure over the past few years, he takes over from Carrrickedmond native Joe Breslin. item.title: Leitrim GAA launch 50 miles fundraising event
item.description: A launch event took place on Wednesday evening in Carrick-on-Shannon for the Leitrim GAA 50 miles fundraising. The fundraiser which first launched in 2021 invites participants to take part using the slogan “walk, run or connect”. The fundraising event invites people to walk or run while connecting with Leitrim supporters both at home and abroad. item.title: WATCH: Hundreds line Carrick's streets as Santa arrives to switch on lights
item.description: Hundreds of people were in Carrick-on-Shannon tonight to watch Santa switch on the Christmas lights. There was a Christmas Lights Parade from the fire station down to the Market Yard beforehand. There were banners to reflect Carrick's success in the SuperValu TidyTowns competition recently, where it won the overall award.
